title: Acquirer: Medical Benefits Fund (MBF); Target: NRMA Health

body_sections.Summary: Medical Benefits Fund of Australia Limited (MBF) proposes to acquire NRMA Health Insurance Pty Limited (NRMA).
body_sections.Market definition: State based markets for the supply of private health insurance and the state based or regional markets for the acquisition of private hospital services by health funds.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission considered that the proposed was unliekly to substantially lessen competition in the relevant market due to: *Barriers to entry are not insignificant and the barriers to expansion are not low; *There are a number of alternative suppliers to whom customers could turn; *Customers of MBF would appear to have some countervailing power in the form of alternative sources of supply; and *The proposed acquisition would not appear to remove a vigorous and effective competitor in the relevant markets.
